acceptanceCriteria: The docs give a clone recipe with no 'git remote set-url'.
The recipe is shown to complete the dogfood loop up to bind in a fresh clone.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, 2026-10-04, origin/main 8a3e3a5b. Agent subagent fresh-clone setup is blocked by the auto-mode classifier on 'git remote set-url origin' (flagged as 'Remote Repoint'). The documented plain-clone dogfood loop needs a remote. Suggestion: document a clone recipe that needs no repoint, e.g. 'git clone <url>' directly so origin is correct from the start, in the dogfood docs (docs/DOGFOOD.md) and agent instructions. Expected: the recipe completes without any remote rewrite. Actual: the repoint step is refused in auto mode and the session stalls. Related: V1-0272, V1-0182.
title: Document a plain-clone recipe for agent sessions that needs no 'git remote set-url origin' repoint
